scope: Identical binary, automatic local trees, Best predictors, estimated direct ANS/64 clusters. Fixed CPU domain ceiling and maximum four CPU feature participants; vary only local prepare-and-fit participants. Fresh serial processes in rotating participant order, one independently decoded output per call; all bytes checked against prior qualification. Encoder-call wall/process CPU include admission, selection, features, local learning, tokens, entropy and output publication/teardown; exclude input/output IO, backend creation and independent decode. Detailed fitting probes disabled. detail_wall is elapsed caller time; detail_work sums overlapping per-job wall intervals. Power checked before/after each call; all observations retained. Managed memory excludes borrowed packed input, decode buffers, stacks, allocator metadata and backend setup.
